meta.org: Krembil Research Institute — UHN Business Hub
meta.description: Complete Salesforce data model for implementing the Krembil AAR on the UHN Business Hub. Includes all custom objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, automation logic, and a 10-step implementation guide.
meta.relationship_model: Hub-and-spoke: 1 master object with 13 Master-Detail children and 1 Lookup to Contact

objects.label: AAR Submission
objects.description: Master record for a scientist's complete annual report. All 13 child objects relate here via Master-Detail. One record per scientist per reporting year.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: System-generated: e.g. AAR-2024-00042.

fields.label: Scientist
fields.description: Lookup to Contact. Drives record ownership and sharing rules.

fields.label: Reporting Year
fields.description: Four-digit year, e.g. 2024.

fields.label: Reporting Start Date
fields.description: Auto-set to Jan 1 of the reporting year.

fields.label: Reporting End Date
fields.description: Auto-set to Dec 31 of the reporting year.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Workflow state of the AAR.

fields.label: Submission Date/Time
fields.description: Timestamp when scientist clicks Submit. Set via Flow automation.

fields.label: Krembil Pillar
fields.description: Which Krembil research pillar the scientist belongs to.

fields.label: Krembil Sub-Grouping
fields.description: Sub-category within the Pillar.

fields.label: Research Career Stage
fields.description: Contextualises output expectations.

fields.label: Research Keywords
fields.description: Up to 5 keywords describing research focus. Drives cross-institute dashboards.

fields.label: Protected Time for Research (%)
fields.description: % of FTE protected for research.

fields.label: Hours Completing AAR
fields.description: Tracks form burden year-over-year for process improvement.

fields.label: Lay Summary of Research
fields.description: Plain-language research description used for public communications.

fields.label: Clinical Duties
fields.description: Description of clinical role and time commitment. Context for workload.

fields.label: Circumstances Affecting Productivity
fields.description: CRITICAL FIELD. Informs how evaluators weight output data. Place prominently on layout.

fields.label: Leave Start Date
fields.description: Start of any formal leave (parental, medical, etc.) in the year.

fields.label: Leave End Date
fields.description: End of leave. Pair with start date for duration calculation.

fields.label: Mandatory Training Complete
fields.description: MyLearning compliance acknowledgement. Must be checked to submit.

fields.label: Patient Engagement Survey Complete
fields.description: PIPER survey completion acknowledgement.

fields.label: CMaRS Disclosure Updated
fields.description: Relationship disclosure and UHN policy compliance declaration.

fields.label: Grants in Good Standing
fields.description: Affirms no grant account deficits.

fields.label: Form Confirmed Accurate
fields.description: Final declaration before submission.

fields.label: Feedback on Form
fields.description: Scientist comments on the AAR form itself. Feeds annual form review process.

objects.label: Scientist (Contact)
objects.description: Extends the standard Salesforce Contact with custom research fields. One Contact owns many AAR Submissions across reporting years.

salesforce_settings.note: Add custom fields to existing Contact object.

fields.label: First Name
fields.description: Standard Salesforce field.

fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: Standard Salesforce field.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Standard field. Primary login and notification address.

fields.label: ORCID
fields.description: 16-digit ORCID (0000-0000-0000-0000). Enables ORCID API auto-populate for publications.

fields.label: UHN PI Profile URL
fields.description: Link to scientist's public UHN research profile page.

fields.label: Primary Research Institute
fields.description: e.g. Krembil Research Institute.

fields.label: UHN Research Appointment
fields.description: Scientist, Senior Scientist, Principal Investigator, etc.

fields.label: Clinical Appointment
fields.description: Free-text clinical title.

fields.label: Is Active Researcher
fields.description: Filter flag for active vs. emeritus/inactive scientists. Used in annual rollover Flow.

objects.label: AAR Appointment
objects.description: Captures UHN and University appointments held in the reporting period. Multiple rows per AAR Submission.

fields.label: AAR Submission
fields.description: Parent record. Deleting the submission cascades to this record.

fields.label: Institution
fields.description: e.g. University of Toronto.

fields.label: Faculty
fields.description: e.g. Faculty of Medicine.

fields.label: Department
fields.description: e.g. Department of Surgery.

fields.label: Appointment Title
fields.description: e.g. Associate Professor.

fields.label: Is Graduate Appointment
fields.description: Whether this allows graduate student supervision.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Leave blank if ongoing.

objects.label: AAR Grant / Funding
objects.description: Tracks all funding — submitted, awarded, declined, and active grants. Each row = one grant application or award.

fields.label: Funding Source
fields.description: Sponsoring agency (e.g. CIHR, NSERC, NIH).

objects.label: AAR Publication
objects.description: Stores peer-reviewed, non-peer-reviewed, and in-progress publications. WOS field restricted to staff via FLS.

fields.label: WOS (Office Use Only)
fields.fls_restriction: Research Admin and Leadership profiles only
fields.description: Web of Science ID. Restrict via field-level security.

objects.label: Highly Qualified Personnel
objects.description: Tracks every trainee and staff member supervised. Feeds HQP pipeline metrics for funder reporting (CIHR, NSERC).

fields.label: Position / Title
fields.description: e.g. PhD Student, Postdoctoral Fellow, Research Coordinator.

objects.label: Teaching & Instruction
objects.description: Records all formal teaching — courses, workshops, grand rounds — delivered in the reporting year.

objects.label: Award & Honour
objects.description: Records prizes, fellowships, named lectureships, and recognition received in the reporting year.

objects.label: Invited Presentation
objects.description: Keynote and plenary presentations only. Regular conference presentations go in AAR_Outreach__c.

objects.label: IP Disclosure
objects.description: Technology disclosures filed with the TDC (Technology Development & Commercialization) office. Pre-patent step.

objects.label: Patent
objects.description: Tracks all patent filings — provisional, utility, PCT, and issued patents.

objects.label: Licensing Agreement
objects.description: Records technology licensing agreements between UHN and third parties for research outputs.

objects.label: Startup Company
objects.description: Records spin-offs or startups founded based on UHN research. Sponsored Research Agreements belong in AAR_Grant__c.

objects.label: Outreach & Media
objects.description: Public outreach events, media appearances, conference attendance, and meeting abstracts. One record per distinct activity.

objects.label: Professional Activity
objects.description: Service contributions — committee work, grant reviewing, professional societies, UHN service, and consulting.

profiles.name: AAR Scientist
profiles.access: Read/Write own records only. Create on all child objects.

profiles.name: AAR Research Admin
profiles.access: Read/Write all records in assigned Pillar. Edit WOS and TDC fields.

profiles.name: AAR Institute Leadership
profiles.access: Read/Write all records across all Pillars.

sharing_rules.criteria: Krembil_Pillar__c matches Research Admin's assigned pillar

validation_rules.error_message: MyLearning training must be completed before you can submit your AAR.
Your CMaRS relationship disclosure must be updated before submission.
All grant accounts must be in good standing before submission.
Please confirm the form is accurate before submitting.

validation_rules.description: Block creation where same Scientist__c + Reporting_Year__c already exists.

validation_rules.error_message: Amount received this year cannot exceed the total award amount.
ePub Date is required for peer-reviewed publications.

automation.name: Flow_AAR_Submission_Trigger
actions: Send confirmation email to Scientist with record link
Send notification email to Research Admin for their Pillar

automation.name: Flow_AAR_Return_Notification
automation.trigger: Status changes to Returned for Revision
actions: Email scientist with reviewer notes from most recent Chatter post on the record

automation.name: Flow_Annual_AAR_Rollover
actions: Query all Contacts where Is_Active_Researcher__c = true
For each Contact, create new AAR_Submission__c with Status = Draft

key_reports.name: Submission Status by Pillar
key_reports.description: Completion rate and overdue submissions across the institute.

key_reports.name: Peer-Reviewed Publications by Career Stage
key_reports.description: Filter current year, group by Research_Career_Stage__c.

key_reports.name: Active Funding by Source
key_reports.description: Filter Grant_Status__c = Funded-Active, group by Funding_Source__c.

key_reports.name: HQP Pipeline by Position
key_reports.description: Count trainees grouped by Position_Title__c for CIHR/NSERC reporting.

dashboards.name: My AAR Progress
dashboards.description: Pin to Lightning Home Page. Shows own submission status and child record counts.

sections.name: Context — PROMINENT PLACEMENT
sections.note: Add help text banner. This section is the most important context for evaluators.

integration_opportunities.benefit: Auto-populate AAR_Publication__c records. Largest potential reduction in scientist data entry burden.
Auto-confirm training completion instead of relying on self-declaration.
Auto-sync disclosure status to remove checkbox self-reporting.
Pre-populate grant records from funding portal APIs.

implementation_steps.title: Org Preparation
tasks: Create named System Admin build user

implementation_steps.title: Create Custom Objects
tasks: Create all 13 custom objects with Reports, Search enabled
Set Deployment Status = Deployed on each object immediately

implementation_steps.title: Build Relationships
tasks: Add Lookup Scientist__c (to Contact) on AAR_Submission__c
Add Master-Detail AAR_Submission__c as FIRST field on each of the 13 child objects

implementation_steps.title: Add Custom Fields
tasks: Add all fields per Objects section above
Add Roll-Up Summary fields on AAR_Submission__c
Use Salesforce CLI / Workbench for bulk field creation

implementation_steps.title: Configure Security Model
tasks: Apply Field-Level Security on WOS and TDC fields

implementation_steps.title: Design Page Layouts
tasks: Add Related Lists in specified order
Add inline help text on all scientist-visible fields
Build Lightning App Page for scientists

implementation_steps.title: Add Validation Rules
tasks: Implement all 7 validation rules from validation_rules section above

implementation_steps.title: Reports & Dashboards
tasks: Build My AAR Progress scientist dashboard
Pin scientist dashboard to Lightning Home Page

implementation_steps.title: Test & Go Live
tasks: Verify record visibility, child record creation, submission blocking, email notifications
Verify FLS: WOS and TDC fields hidden from scientists
Deploy from sandbox to production via Change Set or Salesforce CLI
